value.title: El Protocolo
value.synopsis: With the virus loosed, soldiers cutting off the school, and a makeshift infirmary established to corral those infected, Evelyn decides to fake the illness to make Lucas jealous.

value.title: La Amenaza
value.synopsis: Soldiers deliver four infected outsiders to stay at the boarding school, including Clara and a psychopath.

value.title: El Hombre Misterioso
value.synopsis: As Garrido heads the excavation of the cave-in, a petty thief emerges among the students, and the bald man from Marcos' dream visits other dreamers as well.

value.title: El Tesoro
value.synopsis: Gullible girls prospect the tunnels for pirate plunder, mistrust abounds, sabotage strikes again, and a smuggled gun only creates new troubles within the infirmary.

value.title: El Centro de la Tierra
value.synopsis: With Lucia in need of emergency surgery, Martin hides infected Lucas in the secret loft, Evelyn seeks erotic passion, and the teens seek the scarred bald man of their dreams.

value.title: Los Tres Pétalos
value.synopsis: The dig continues; the medicine runs low. Diluting what remains by half seems the best option. As Curro begins groundwork for an insurrection, Evelyn's decision to divorce Lucas leads to a breech.

value.title: El Asesino de Carolina
value.synopsis: As the medicine runs out and a fresh murder comes to light, trouble brews in the infirmary, and the teens await the promised reveal of Carolina's killer.

value.title: El Último Deseo
value.synopsis: Taking over the infirmary, Curro gives the school one hour to bring medication or else they'll break out; unfortunately, the staff comes to realize they've been misdirected to uncover the wrong cache.

value.title: El Principio del Fin
value.synopsis: As the infection spreads, a special delivery from Greece reveals truer plans for those quarantined at the school.

value.title: La Última Dosis (Final)
value.synopsis: Tensions rise as the medicine reaches its end and senior students plot an escape. Meanwhile, Max' captors hit a snag spawned by the Nazi's own deviousness.

value.title: Los Últimos Recuerdos
value.synopsis: With Fermin's life in immediate danger, the teens hunt for another Nazi mole while envious children, eyeing chocolate, convince Paula she's getting too fat.

value.title: Hasta Que La Muerte Nos Separe
value.synopsis: Still quarantined with doom all around, the school moves quickly to transact a wedding.

value.title: El Ùltimo Aliento
value.synopsis: Ruben's sudden tirade goads student unrest towards insurrection, turning all but Marcos towards ideas of escape. Meanwhile, Fermin and Rebeca seek to retrieve Max, and Elsa plans for the end.

value.title: La Luz
value.synopsis: Two cure machines have been built but neither can work without uranium and no one knows who has it. Ivan's health deteriorates.

value.title: El Fin
value.synopsis: End game. Fermin leads an escape plan, but two remaining undercover agents at the school aim to spoil it. All confrontations become final.
